title: Stability of orthognathic surgery and condylar resorption in mild craniofacial microsomia compared to non-syndromic Class II asymmetry
html: This study was performed to compare skeletal stability and condylar resorption after bimaxillary surgery between adults with mild craniofacial microsomia (CFM) and those with non-syndromic skeletal Class II asymmetry. Cone-beam computed tomography images of two groups were analysed: CFM group (n = 20), Class II group (n = 20). Voxel- and landmark-based methods were used to quantify the translation and rotation of osteotomy segments during surgery and at follow-up. Changes in condylar volume were measured at follow-up.
